app_fee.value: There are no application or tuition fees for PhD studies at Lund University (the SEK 900 fee applies only to Bachelor's and Master's applications via universityadmissions.se).
app_fee.quote: There are no application or tuition fees for: ... PhD studies

also.quote: You can pursue your doctoral studies in any of the nine faculties, and there are no tuition fees. Regular doctoral positions come with a salary and formal employment at the University.

fee_waiver.value: Not applicable — there are no application or tuition fees for PhD studies at Lund University.
fee_waiver.quote: There are no application or tuition fees for: ... PhD studies

gre_general.value: No GRE requirement is mentioned on Lund's doctoral studies page or in its 2024 Admission Rules for Doctoral Education.

toefl_min.value: Lund sets no university-wide doctoral TOEFL cutoff; individual departments may request a TOEFL or IELTS test (the TOEFL 90 / IELTS 6.5 standard on the English requirements page is for Bachelor's/Master's degree studies).
toefl_min.quote: Candidates must have a very good command of English and you may be asked to include proof of proficiency in the form of a TOEFL or IELTS test, if requested by the individual department.

ielts_min.value: Lund sets no university-wide doctoral IELTS cutoff; individual departments may request a TOEFL or IELTS test (the IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL 90 standard on the English requirements page is for Bachelor's/Master's degree studies).
ielts_min.quote: Candidates must have a very good command of English and you may be asked to include proof of proficiency in the form of a TOEFL or IELTS test, if requested by the individual department.

english_waiver.value: Doctoral English proof is requested at the discretion of individual departments; Lund states no university-wide doctoral exemption rule for English-medium degrees from India.
english_waiver.quote: Candidates must have a very good command of English and you may be asked to include proof of proficiency in the form of a TOEFL or IELTS test, if requested by the individual department.

notes: Doctoral students at Lund University are admitted by each of the nine faculties via advertised vacancies (Varbi) with formal employment and monthly salary, and there are no application or tuition fees for PhD studies. Checked doctoral studies page, 2024 Admission Rules for Doctoral Education PDF, tuition fees page, application fee page, and English requirements page.
